description: Implementation of ConnectServerBackend class handling CONNECT and CONNECT-UDP requests, managing tunnels, and forwarding responses in a QUIC server context.

classes.name: ConnectServerBackend
classes.description: Handles incoming CONNECT and CONNECT-UDP requests, manages tunnels, and interacts with backend server.

methods.name: SendErrorResponse
methods.description: Sends an error response with specified error code to the request handler.

methods.name: ConnectServerBackend
methods.description: Constructor initializing backend with acceptable destinations and UDP targets.

methods.name: ~ConnectServerBackend
methods.description: Destructor ensuring all tunnels are closed.

methods.name: IsBackendInitialized
methods.description: Checks if backend is initialized; always returns true.

methods.name: SetSocketFactory
methods.description: Sets the socket factory used for creating tunnels.

methods.name: FetchResponseFromBackend
methods.description: Forwards response fetch to non-connect backend.

methods.name: HandleConnectHeaders
methods.description: Handles CONNECT and CONNECT-UDP headers, opens appropriate tunnels or forwards to backend.

methods.name: HandleConnectData
methods.description: Processes data for established tunnels or forwards to backend if no tunnel found.

methods.name: CloseBackendResponseStream
methods.description: Closes tunnels and cleans up when response stream is closed.
